meta.title: VAZORA — Evidence Intelligence
meta.description: VAZORA turns requirements into verified reality. Contract Intelligence for the execution phase: obligations, evidence, verification, risk and claim readiness.

common.demoDataHint: Illustrative demo environment. Figures are not customer results.

nav.contractIntelligenceHint: From award to payment: obligations, evidence, verification and claims.
nav.assessorHint: Specialized virtual assessors for standards and regulatory readiness.

footer.blurb: Evidence Intelligence for organizations that must prove what they deliver.

hero.title: VAZORA turns requirements into verified reality.
hero.subtitle: After award, every clause becomes an obligation, every obligation needs evidence, and every claim depends on proof. VAZORA verifies all of it — continuously.

signature.officerMessage: Clause 14.2 SLA logs missing for August — claim #5 blocked.

problem.title: Contracts are signed with precision and executed with hope.
problem.body: After award, the contract disappears into folders. Obligations live in people's heads. Evidence arrives late, incomplete or unverified. By the time a claim is disputed or a penalty is applied, the proof was never there.

points.title: Obligations without owners
points.body: Hundreds of requirements, scattered across clauses, schedules and amendments — with nobody accountable for each one.

points.title: Evidence that proves nothing
points.body: A file exists. It is not the right file, the right period, the right signature or the right KPI.

points.title: Claims discovered late
points.body: Missing proof surfaces during review, not before submission — delaying payment and weakening the position.

shift.title: Not a document store. A system that knows whether you can prove it.
shift.body: VAZORA reads the awarded contract, structures every obligation, connects each one to the evidence it requires, and evaluates whether that evidence actually satisfies the clause — before anyone asks.

lifecycle.title: Built for the phase where money is won or lost.
lifecycle.body: Most tools stop at signature. VAZORA starts there.

evidence.title: Uploaded is not verified.
evidence.body: Every evidence item is checked against the clause it serves — period, scope, signatures, KPIs, acknowledgements. VAZORA tells you what is proven, what is partial, and exactly what is missing.

officer.title: Intelligence that speaks first.
officer.body: Not a chatbot waiting for a prompt. The Contract Officer monitors deadlines, evidence gaps, risk exposure and claim readiness — and raises what needs attention, with the clause and the money attached.

feed.text: August SLA logs (Clause 14.2) still missing. Deduction exposure: SAR 420,000.
Deliverable 4 acceptance (Clause 21.3) due in 6 days. Only commissioning report on file.
Claim #5 readiness 82% — 3 requirements open. Target submission: 30 Sep.
HVAC PM records for August verified against Clause 8.4.

claim.title: Know why a claim is not ready — before you submit it.
claim.body: Every claim is decomposed into the evidence it depends on. Readiness is computed from verified requirements, not from a checklist someone ticked.

assessor.title: VAZORA Assessor
assessor.body: The same evidence intelligence, pointed at standards. Specialized virtual assessors that evaluate your readiness against a framework — clause by clause, with evidence.

trust.title: Designed for organizations that answer to auditors.

items.title: Organization-isolated data
items.body: Every record is scoped to your organization. Isolation is enforced at the data layer, not the interface.

items.title: Traceable decisions
items.body: Each verification links back to the original clause, the requirement and the evidence that satisfied it.

items.title: Human in control
items.body: VAZORA surfaces, quantifies and recommends. People decide, approve and submit.

items.title: Built for Arabic and English
items.body: Native right-to-left experience. Contract terminology handled in both languages.

cta.title: See your contract as obligations, evidence and readiness.
cta.body: A 45-minute working session with one of your active contracts.

ci.title: From award to payment, with proof.
ci.subtitle: Contract Intelligence turns an awarded contract into a living system of obligations, evidence, verification, risk and claims — for contractors, operators and service providers who must prove delivery.

items.title: Contract structuring
items.body: Clauses, schedules and amendments become discrete obligations with owners, cadence and required evidence.

items.title: Evidence verification
items.body: Each item is judged against the clause it serves: period, scope, signatures, KPIs, acknowledgements.

items.title: Risk exposure
items.body: Penalties and deductions quantified per clause, with time to impact — before they are applied.

items.title: Claim readiness
items.body: Every claim decomposed into requirements. Readiness computed from verified proof.

items.title: AI Contract Officer
items.body: Proactive monitoring that raises what needs attention, with the clause and amount attached.

items.title: Traceability
items.body: Original clause → requirement → evidence → verification → decision. Always.

workspace.title: One place where the contract, the proof and the money meet.
workspace.body: Health indicators are counted, not scored. Every number opens into the obligations, evidence and clauses behind it.

items.a: No. CLM manages drafting, negotiation and signature. VAZORA begins after award and focuses on execution, evidence and claims.

items.q: Is it a document management system?
items.a: No. Files are stored, but the value is in knowing whether a file proves what a clause requires.

items.q: Is the AI Contract Officer a chatbot?
items.a: It can answer questions, but its primary role is to monitor and raise issues proactively — with clause references and exposure.
VAZORA surfaces, quantifies and recommends. Approval and submission remain with your team.

assessor.title: Virtual assessors for standards, built on evidence.
assessor.subtitle: Assessor applies VAZORA's evidence intelligence to frameworks and regulatory requirements. Each assessor knows a standard, structures its requirements, and evaluates your evidence against them.

steps.title: Framework structured
steps.body: A standard's requirements are decomposed into assessable items with evidence expectations.

steps.title: Evidence mapped
steps.body: Your policies, records and logs are linked to each requirement.

steps.title: Readiness assessed
steps.body: Each item is judged verified, partial or missing — with what would close the gap.

assessor.note: Assessor does not issue certifications or represent any accreditation body. It prepares organizations for assessment with evidence.
